title: Hematopoietic cell transplantation and cellular therapy 1: the basics of transplantation

units.assessment: Can you explain why an autologous graft is essentially a rescue from chemotherapy dose intensity while an allogeneic graft is itself the therapy, and can you name the phases the transplant process is divided into?
